quote.text: The reason why we have two ears and only one mouth is that we may listen the more and talk the less.
quote.author: Zeno
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • In raising children, employ the wisdom of quiet observation; let silence be the space where you truly understand their unspoken needs and emotions.
    • By listening more and speaking less, you invite your children to open up, ensuring that their inner voices grow stronger and their individuality is respected.
  • Leadership
    • A leader who listens, rather than habitually speaking, creates an environment of trust and mutual understanding, empowering team members to contribute their best ideas.
    • Make it a daily practice to silently absorb the perspectives of those around you, for in quiet reflection you forge decisions that benefit the whole organization.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, attentive listening to customer feedback and team insights is the key that unlocks continuous improvement and innovative solutions.
    • Embrace a mindset where every given piece of feedback is an opportunity—by listening more, you refine strategies and ensure that your products truly meet real needs.
